name: T-90A Tank
description: T-90A main battle tank: It is a main battle tank developed by Russia. The body is improved from the T-72. The early turret is a cast turret similar to the T-72, but the later turret is a redesigned welded turret, and the fire control system adopts the T-80U fire control system. It was mainly developed to deal with the threat of NATO at that time. Almost all of it was deployed in the Western Military District and the Ural Military District. It has been used as a defensive weapon in Russia and was only exported to India in recent years.
